description: Expose vault token in loop variable — T5 deny

playbook.content:
- name: Iterate over tokens
  hosts: all
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: 'Token is {{ item }}'
      loop: '{{ vault_tokens }}'

tier_rationale: Loop iterates over vault_tokens and exposes each via debug msg
common_mistakes: ansible-lint: no rule for loop+debug+sensitive vars
